question: The Jammu and Kashmir Reorganization (Amendment) Bill, 2021 was introduced in the Rajya Sabha on _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**February 4, 2021.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Jammu and Kashmir Reorganization (Amendment) Bill, 2021** was **introduced **in the** Rajya Sabha on February 4, 2021.**
 
• The bill was passed by the Rajya Sabha on February 8, 2021, and by the Lok Sabha on February 13, 2021, and received the President's assent on March 28, 2021.
 
• The bill **seeks to amend the Jammu and Kashmir Reorganization Act, 2019.**
 
 
• The amendments **proposed **in the bill include **changes to the composition of the Legislative Council of Jammu and Kashmir**, which was abolished in 2019, and the **reservation of seats in the Legislative Assembly for the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Jammu and Kashmir Reorganization Act, 2019:**

 
• **On August 5, 2019**, the Jammu and Kashmir Reorganisation ACT, 2019 was **approved**, **dividing **the** region into the Union Territories of Jammu and Kashmir **and **Ladakh.**
 
• The Act also **repealed Article 370**, which had granted **Jammu and Kashmir special status.**
 
• **On October 31, 2019**, the day of Sardar **Vallabhbhai Patel's birth**, which is observed as **National Unity Day**, **it came into force.**
 
• **Five Lok Sabha seats in Jammu and Kashmir** were retained by the Union Territory of Jammu and Kashmir, while **one was transferred to the Union Territory of Ladakh.**
